reviews.name: CActorCommander::FUN_001710c0
reviews.reason: Ghidra CTeamElt has size 24 and pEnemyActor at offset 16. PS2 00171140 advances the byte offset by 0x18; the port uses aTeamElt[iVar3].pEnemyActor. Branches, per-enemy call and early return match. Reviewed against decompilation and disassembly on 2026-10-22.

reviews.name: CFxNewParticle::SetTimeScaler
reviews.reason: PS2 0032cff4 stores the incoming float f12 to this+0x80 in the return delay slot. The fixed port assigns the incoming timeScale to float field_0x80. The raw offset is represented by the named field. Reviewed against decompilation and disassembly on 2026-10-22.
